_about: Tolerances for tools/run-baseline.py, keyed by reference file name. A file not listed here must match exactly. See docs/testing.md.

four-sections.2016.tangent.nlelem.reason: Segment 18's control handles differ by up to 0.975 mm from the 2016 binary. It sits in the tight loop of the geometric section, where mnode::exportNode() computes the handle length as radius * tan(angle / 2) with the angle near 180 degrees, so the last bit of a float moves the result by a millimetre on a handle about 8 m long. The end points are identical.
